notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
Nmap with ms-sql* NSE scripts against port 1433 retrieves hostname, NetBIOS name, exact MSSQL version, instance name, DAC port, named pipe path, and tests for empty sa password. ms-sql-ntlm-info leaks domain/computer names without completing auth.

=== CHAINING ===
nmap ms-sql* → version + instance name → msf mssql_ping (UDP 1434 for named instances) → mssqlclient.py → enumerate databases → check xp_cmdshell.

=== XP_CMDSHELL ===
ms-sql-xp-cmdshell NSE tests if xp_cmdshell is enabled — direct OS command execution. If disabled: requires SA privileges to enable via sp_configure.
